YAML 1.2 Anchors & Flow 25 API Methods

YAML (YML) Tools

A zero-dependency YAML 1.2 core specification tools suite. Mappings, nested sequences, literal (|) and folded (>) block scalars, anchors & aliases (&/*), flow styles, key reordering, and deep diffing.

YAML 1.2 Specification
25 Tool Operations
& / * Anchors & Aliases
Flow Compression

YAML 1.2 Capabilities

Anchors & Aliases

Define reusable nodes with &anchor and inject references seamlessly using *alias with circular check safety.

YmlEngine.parse(yamlWithAnchors)

Block & Flow Styles

Support both block-indented structures and compact flow collections with JSON interoperability.

YmlEngine.compress(yamlText)

Path Getters & Key Reordering

Mutate deep documents using dot-notation paths, reorder keys alphabetically or according to schema priority.

YmlEngine.reorderKeys(yaml, ['name', 'version'])

Cross-Format Bridges

Convert YAML directly to JSON, XML, CSV, or Markdown tables with zero information loss.

YmlEngine.toJson(yamlText)

Interactive Code Example

import { YmlEngine } from '/assets/js/index.js';

const yaml = `service: Datafrog\nversion: 2.1\nenv:\n  - production\n  - staging`;

// 1. Parse and deep mutate
const parsed = YmlEngine.parse(yaml);
YmlEngine.set(parsed, 'env.2', 'sandbox');

// 2. Key reordering and sorting
const sorted = YmlEngine.sortKeys(parsed);

// 3. Deep diff against source
const diff = YmlEngine.diff(yaml, sorted);
console.log('Diff summary:', diff.summary);
